sentences.text: Mucopolysaccharidosis type 3A is linked to the gene SGSH, and type 3B to the gene NAGLU, both in curated databases [e_e3e8357f997b] [e_244c274fe2aa].
Both genes take part in the same curated pathway, heparan sulfate degradation [e_5b584a90f37e] [e_b88b530788ef].
Constellate computed that types 3A and 3B look very much alike in their listed symptoms, with a score of 0.783, which is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_9f54c1efee87].
For type 3A, recurrent upper airway infections are an observed feature, recorded in 61 of 70 people [e_57928ff6fc8f].
Reduced activity of a white blood cell enzyme is also listed for type 3A, with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_4d44692bc637].
For type 3B, two studies are listed as not yet recruiting, one gene therapy study and one drug study [e_fd55a029b67d] [e_deceb25dcde4].
A gene therapy grant is also listed for type 3B [e_115b02ebc882].
These edges do not show results of any study, and they list no study for type 3A [e_fd55a029b67d].
